field_guidance.seed_id: Stable slug unique inside the vendor pack, e.g. claude-hci-direct-manipulation-1970s.
field_guidance.primary_lineage: Exactly one primary lineage from the lineage catalog. Cross-domain links are not primary lineage.
field_guidance.era_or_date_range: Coarse era only (decade, product generation, or 'undated'). Never invent an exact publication date.
field_guidance.observed_example: The recalled interface, object, or practice. Describe the form, not a quote dump.
field_guidance.problem_or_conditions: What job, failure, or environment that form answered.
field_guidance.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Hardware, software, social, or regulatory constraints that made the form possible or necessary.
field_guidance.interaction_form: How a human actually acted: command, conversation, spatial, notification, approval, monitor, etc.
field_guidance.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Recalled praise, backlash, accessibility failure, or operational critique. Mark uncertainty.
field_guidance.suspected_source_or_example: Named class of source (book, demo, product, paper, folklore). Do not fabricate a precise citation, DOI, URL, page, or quote.
field_guidance.observation_vs_inference: OBSERVATION for a recalled fact-like memory; INFERENCE for a causal story you are constructing now.
field_guidance.uncertainty: LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH plus one sentence on why.
field_guidance.relevance_clue: Why this seed might later matter to autonomous-agent command surfaces. Do not name a current product UI proposal.
field_guidance.coding_agent_bias: How coding-agent training (CLI, diffs, PRs, tests, chat-with-tools) might distort this recall.

lineage_catalog.label: HCI / interaction
lineage_catalog.ask: Direct manipulation, conversation, command, form-filling, spatial, multimodal; what problems each solved.

lineage_catalog.label: Computing interfaces
lineage_catalog.ask: Batch, time-sharing, GUI, CLI, notebook, IDE, web app; continuity of control vs. visibility of state.

lineage_catalog.label: Mobile / messaging
lineage_catalog.ask: SMS, iMessage, WhatsApp, WeChat, notification shade, chat-as-OS, interruption cost.

lineage_catalog.label: Industrial design
lineage_catalog.ask: Physical controls, cockpits, handheld tools, mode errors, tactile confirmation.

lineage_catalog.label: Technology evolution
lineage_catalog.ask: Always-on networks, background compute, push, local vs cloud agents, battery and attention budgets.

lineage_catalog.label: Graphic / visual communication
lineage_catalog.ask: Status typography, dashboards, iconography, density vs glanceability.

lineage_catalog.label: Architecture / spatial
lineage_catalog.ask: Rooms, control rooms, war rooms, kitchens, workshops as metaphors for software places.

lineage_catalog.label: Accessibility
lineage_catalog.ask: Screen readers, motor limits, cognitive load, color/contrast, interruption and recovery.

lineage_catalog.label: Social / cultural behavior
lineage_catalog.ask: Delegation, trust of intermediaries, etiquette of interruption, status in groups.

lineage_catalog.label: Command lines
lineage_catalog.ask: REPL, shells, xterm, job control, stdout as evidence, dangerous flags, tty vs GUI.

lineage_catalog.label: Dashboards / control rooms
lineage_catalog.ask: Overview first, alarm vs status, operator authority, wall vs handheld.

lineage_catalog.label: Approvals / notifications
lineage_catalog.ask: Interrupt, inbox, two-person rule, push approval, silent vs blocking consent.

lineage_catalog.label: Progressive disclosure
lineage_catalog.ask: Novice/expert paths, details-on-demand, hidden power, leaky abstraction costs.

lineage_catalog.label: Long-running monitoring
lineage_catalog.ask: Jobs, daemons, CI, spacecraft, plants: how humans watch work that outlives a session.

lineage_catalog.label: Multi-agent coordination
lineage_catalog.ask: Human teams, air traffic, trading floors, orchestras, software multi-agent; shared state and dissent.

lineage_catalog.label: Trust / explainability
lineage_catalog.ask: Why a system is believed, audit trails, black boxes, expert override, recovery after surprise.

lineage_catalog.label: Desktop / mobile continuity
lineage_catalog.ask: Handoff, companion devices, notifications as remote controls, what belongs on a small screen.

cross_link_rule.text: Do not flatten knowledge into one chronology or blob. A Seed has one primary lineage. Typed cross-domain causal links are candidate interpretations only, listed separately, never merged into the seed's primary lineage.

phase_1_forbidden: file inspection of a product repository
inventing precise citations, quotes, page numbers, or URLs
adopting RAG, Feature Nodes, Goals, or Todos

model_self_report_required.self_identified_model_family: plain string, no claim of exact checkpoint
model_self_report_required.recall_posture: what kind of design memory this model believes it has
